headline: Last session: Sensex slipped into red while Nifty gained 75 points; smallcaps showed mixed trends amid volatility.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Sensex slipped into the red after initial gains during the last trading session
Nifty managed to gain 75 points despite broader market volatility and selling pressure
Concerns over FII flows and crude oil prices influenced investor sentiment
Mixed performance in small-cap stocks contributed to the uneven closing trend
whatHappening: Investors are focusing on the upcoming week's outlook from September 21-25
FinMin is meeting bank chiefs to address a potential three-day banking strike
Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East involving Saudi Aramco are being monitored
The semiconductor ecosystem development is facing warnings regarding cyberattack disruptions
